queue.title: What If You Grew 10x Bigger Every 5 Seconds? 😳
queue.caption: At 18,000 km tall you'd be taller than Earth is wide… and a stubbed toe would take almost 2 days to hurt 💀 Part 2: you shrink. Follow so you don't miss it.

queue.title: What If Every Sneeze Was 10x Stronger? 🤧
queue.caption: Sneeze 3 breaks the sound barrier. Sneeze 7 launches you across the city. Granny still said bless you 👵 Which sneeze would you survive?

queue.title: What If Your Body Temperature Never Stopped Rising? 🔥
queue.caption: 100°C: you boil your sweat. 1,538°C: steel melts. 5,500°C: you're as hot as the surface of the Sun… and mom still says bring a jacket 🧥

premise_bank: What if you stopped blinking for 24 hours?
What if gravity only got stronger on YOU?
What if your shadow came alive?

plan_november.premise: What if you shrank 10x every 5 seconds?
plan_november.notes: Part 2 of grow. Counter: height (1.8 m → atom). Room → carpet jungle → dust mite → skin cell → DNA → atom. Look: switch to glowing x-ray/wireframe world as you get tiny. Payoff: you're now so small that... part 3 tease.

plan_november.premise: What if every hiccup launched you 10x higher?
plan_november.notes: Part 2 of sneeze. Counter: hiccup # + altitude. Backyard → rooftop → clouds → plane window (passenger waves) → space → passing the Moon. Rival angle: little sister counting hiccups. Ends 'hic' teaser.

plan_november.premise: What if your body temperature never stopped dropping?
plan_november.notes: Part 2 of heat. Counter: °C down to −273. Drink freezes, frost spreads over street, −78 dry-ice snow, −183 air turns to liquid drops around you, −273 absolute zero. Mom offers hot cocoa.

plan_november.premise: What if you jumped into a tunnel through the Earth?
plan_november.notes: Journey. Counter: depth km + speed. Crust → mantle glow → core (5,000+°C) → you fly out the other side ~42 min later (no air resistance) and fall back. Tourist on the other side takes a selfie.

plan_november.premise: What if your house was left alone for 1,000 years?
plan_november.notes: Time-lapse (progress-bar counter like the 1000-years reference). Years 1→1,000: weeds, roof caves, trees through the floor, deer on Main St. Your phone still at 1%. NO TikTok (monthly quota).

plan_november.premise: What if the Moon got 10x closer every 5 seconds?
plan_november.notes: Environment star. Counter: Moon distance (384,400 km →). Tides rise, Moon fills the sky, Roche limit: it breaks into a ring. Neighbor's telescope becomes useless (too close).

plan_november.premise: What if your voice got 10x louder with every word?
plan_november.notes: Counter: decibels. Whisper → shout → jet engine → windows shatter → measurable earthquake → payoff: in space no one hears you (no air).

plan_november.premise: What if you dove to the deepest point of the ocean?
plan_november.notes: Journey. Counter: depth m + pressure. Reef → twilight zone → anglerfish glow → Titanic depth (3,800 m) → Challenger Deep ~10,900 m, ~1,000x surface pressure. Bioluminescence = glow polish.

plan_november.premise: What if your hair doubled in length every second?
plan_november.notes: Counter: hair length. Bathroom → fills house → spills down street → wraps the city → wraps the Earth around second 26. Barber faints.

plan_november.premise: What if you stood on every planet for 5 seconds?
plan_november.notes: Tour. Counter: planet + your weight + temperature. Mercury → Venus (crushing heat) → Mars → Jupiter (no ground) → Saturn → Uranus → Neptune. Same pose + selfie on each.

plan_november.premise: What if a mosquito grew 10x bigger every 5 seconds?
plan_november.notes: Environment star + funny rival. Counter: mosquito size. Ear buzz → cat-sized → car-sized → blocks the sun. You try the fly swatter every beat.

plan_november.premise: What if you never had to sleep again?
plan_november.notes: Time-lapse. Counter: days awake + 'extra hours gained'. Funny montage of what you do with 8 extra hours/day; payoff: you finish every series ever made. NO TikTok (monthly quota).

plan_november.premise: What if your weight doubled every 5 seconds?
plan_november.notes: Counter: kg. Scale breaks → floor → you sink into the street → mantle → you become denser than a neutron star → black hole tease. Pizza delivery guy at the door.

plan_november.premise: What if the Earth spun 2x faster every minute?
plan_november.notes: Environment star (inverse of the 'Earth stopped spinning' reference, original take). Counter: day length + equator speed. Days flicker, winds, you get lighter at the equator, oceans bulge.

plan_november.premise: What if you jumped from the edge of space?
plan_november.notes: Journey. Counter: altitude + fall speed. 39 km capsule (real record jumps ~39–41 km), break the sound barrier, parachute over a city. Grandma on a lawn chair below.

plan_november.premise: What if your Thanksgiving dinner never stopped growing?
plan_november.notes: US Thanksgiving (Nov 26). Counter: turkey size. Plate → table → dining room → neighborhood → visible from space. Uncle still asks for seconds.

plan_november.premise: What if your burp was the loudest sound on Earth?
plan_november.notes: After Thanksgiving. Counter: decibels vs famous loud events (rockets, volcano). Shockwave rolls across town; payoff: the turkey from yesterday says thanks.

plan_november.premise: What if you swallowed a marble-sized black hole?
plan_november.notes: Counter: time left / mass. Inside-body x-ray visuals → house → planet. Keep it cartoon, no gore.

plan_november.premise: What if you walked around the entire Earth?
plan_november.notes: Time-lapse journey. Counter: km walked + days (~40,000 km). Shoes worn out, crosses deserts, swims oceans (cheat with a raft). NO TikTok (monthly quota).

plan_november.premise: What if time moved 10x faster every 5 seconds — just for you?
plan_november.notes: Month finale. Counter: time multiplier. World slows to a freeze, raindrops hang, light turns red, you see the stars move. Ends with a December tease.

style_notes: Counter variety: big pill (ours), elegant serif top-left with small sub-label (electrons/earth-spin/run-speed refs), progress bar for time-lapses (1000-years ref).
Add a tier badge under the counter that upgrades each beat (e.g. HUMAN → BUILDING → MOUNTAIN → PLANET), like the run-speed ref's rank tags.
Expressive character faces and reactions at each beat (Roblox school-story ref); one recurring side character per episode (neighbor, granny, mom, rival).
One-sentence caption per beat in italic serif OR word-by-word pop captions; never both at the same spot.
Endings loop or restart (run-speed ref restarts at 'Minute 0'), or tease the part 2 that is already in the plan.
Do not copy other creators' premises, characters or captions; take the format, not the content.

styles.A_explainer: Current style. Female narrator (Kokoro af_heart, speed 1.1), 2nd person 'you', big title + pill counter, word-by-word captions, 40–48 s.
styles.B_silent_cinematic: NO voiceover (like the electrons / Earth-stops-spinning / run-speed references). Music + sound design carry it. One short italic serif line per beat (e.g. 'You do not. Nothing does.'), elegant small serif counter top-left with a sub-label and an upgrading tier badge, slower camera, colour-graded cinematic look. 35–45 s.
styles.C_first_person_story: A character tells it as 'I…' (like the golden-drops / Roblox school-story references): opens mid-drama ('I looked in the mirror this morning, and…'), states the world's rule, personal stakes, a twist, cliffhanger. Fast and emotional (~3.5–4 words/s), expressive blocky character with big eyes/mouth reacting every beat, word-by-word captions. Male voice (Kokoro am_puck or am_michael). 61–75 s so TikTok counts it as > 1 min.
styles.D_warm_explainer: Calm, comforting 'you' narrator with a small joke in every beat (like the 'everyone slept 1,000 years' reference: 'At least the rent has finally gone down', 'Earth is slowly cleaning out its attic'). Timeline/progress-bar counter, cozy lighting, a cute side character (raccoon/parrot style). Male voice (Kokoro bm_george or am_michael), ~2.6 words/s, 61–75 s.

style_test.goal: Find which style gets the best YouTube Shorts retention and growth; ~4 videos per style by Nov 27.
style_test.metrics: averageViewPercentage, averageViewDuration, engagedViews, subscribersGained per 1k views (vidIQ vidiq_channel_analytics, dimensions=[video], 5 credits).
